The console appears to be a standard Xbox One S model, not a disc-based version.

risks.risk: The console may not be an All-Digital Edition or may still have a disc drive.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console's back or side showing the disc drive or model label, or a video of the console booting up and showing the system settings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard disc-based Xbox One S, which is lower value than an All-Digital Edition.

risks.risk: The console may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, displaying the Xbox dashboard, and connecting to a TV or monitor.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: The console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number.
risks.proof: A photo of the serial number sticker on the back or bottom of the console, and a verification check via Microsoft's official website.
risks.if_unproven: priced with a discount for potential legal or warranty issues.

proof_requests: Photo of the back or bottom of the console showing the model number or serial number.
Video of the console powering on and showing the Xbox dashboard.
Photo of the disc drive or model label if available.
Verification of the serial number via Microsoft's official website.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
